Based on the retrieved excerpts, ISO 45001's competence requirements for your field service technicians are found in **clause 7.2** (Doc 1).

## What You Must Ensure

For workers who affect or can affect OH&S performance — which includes your field service technicians working alone at customer sites — you must ensure they are **competent on the basis of education, training or experience**, including specifically **the ability to identify hazards** (Doc 1 — clause 7.2).

Given the nature of their work, this would encompass:
- Technical competence for their service tasks
- **Hazard identification skills** relevant to varied customer site conditions
- Ability to assess risks when working without direct supervision

## What You Must Document

You must **retain documented evidence of competence** (Doc 1 — clause 7.2). This documented information falls under the broader requirements of **clause 7.5** (Doc 2), which requires proper identification, format, review/approval, and controls for availability and protection.

## Additional Related Requirements

Your technicians' solitary work also implicates:
- **Clause 6.1.3** (Doc 3): You must determine and access up-to-date legal requirements applicable to their hazards and OH&S risks, and retain documented information on these requirements
- **Clause 9.1.2** (Doc 5): You must evaluate compliance with legal requirements, maintain knowledge of compliance status, and retain documented information of compliance evaluation results

## Summary Table

| Requirement | Clause | Key Action |
|-------------|--------|-----------|
| Ensure competence (education/training/experience + hazard identification) | 7.2 | Train and assess technicians |
| Retain documented evidence of competence | 7.2 | Maintain training records, certifications, assessments |
| Control documented information | 7.5 | Proper identification, storage, access, retention |
| Determine applicable legal requirements | 6.1.3 | Identify lone worker regulations, site-specific requirements |
| Evaluate and document compliance | 9.1.2 | Periodic compliance assessment |
